title: Nonvanishing of the enumerated vectors
statement: Let $\ell,n$ be nonnegative integers with $n\le 2^\ell-1$, and let $j\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. The vector assigned to $j$ by the enumeration of nonzero vectors in $\mathbb F_2^\ell$ is nonzero.
